payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort songs by compression savings (a-b), then greedily decompress songs with smallest savings to maximize uncompressed count while staying under capacity.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the array of differences (a-b) and then iteratively adds them to the all-compressed sum, effectively decompressing songs in order of increasing size increase to find the minimum number of compressions needed. This uses sorting by a derived key.
